answer_model.instructions: Which model should write the reply to this request, if any?

criteria.claude-opus-5-5: Most requests: questions, explanations, advice, in-depth analysis, research-style knowledge work, long-form writing, coding, and system design; also creative writing such as stories, screenplays, dialogue, roleplay, and characters.
criteria.gpt-6-astra: Long agent runs that use many tools or operate a terminal or computer, large code migrations, high-stakes work where a factual mistake would be costly, and math: proofs, equations, derivations, or competition-level problems.
criteria.gpt-5.5-pro: A single very hard problem that needs long, careful thought: difficult logic, tricky quantitative analysis, or a question where accuracy matters far more than speed.
criteria.gpt-5.5: Moderate tasks that should come back quickly and polished: customer-facing replies, business documents and deliverables, everyday coding, and classifying, extracting, tagging, or labeling information from text.
criteria.kimi-k3: The request is in Chinese or is bilingual Chinese/English, or it is long-horizon coding across a large repository, or it involves a very long document.
criteria.none: The request only asks to generate or edit an image, video, or audio, and that output is the whole reply.

search_model.instructions: Which model should search the web for this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not need current information from the web.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-pro: Most web questions: a complex question answered by combining facts from several sources, with citations.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-pro-search: A question that needs several searches in a row, where later searches depend on what earlier ones found.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-deep-research: The user wants an exhaustive research report or a thorough investigation of a topic and is willing to wait for it.

image_model.instructions: Which model should generate or edit the image in this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not ask to create or edit an image. Questions about images or pictures don't count.
criteria.gemini-3-pro-image: Any image to generate or edit, including legible text, many reference images, and production-ready assets.

video_generation_model.instructions: Which model should generate the video in this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not ask to create a new video. Questions about videos don't count.
criteria.veo-3.1-generate-preview: Any video to generate, including cinematic clips with synchronized dialogue.

video_editing_model.instructions: Which model should edit the video in this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not ask to change an existing video.
criteria.runway-aleph-2: Any video edit: restyling, relighting, swapping a product, or consistent edits across shots, on clips up to 30 seconds.

audio_generation_model.instructions: Which model should generate the audio in this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not ask to create audio such as speech, a song, or music. Questions about music or audio don't count.
criteria.qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus: Spoken voice: text to speech, narration, voiceover, audiobooks, broadcast-style reading, Chinese dialects, or speech with delivery cues such as whispering or laughing.
criteria.lyria-3-pro-preview: Music: songs with sung vocals or instrumental tracks, soundtracks, and pieces where the user specifies detailed musical control.
criteria.elevenlabs-music-v2: Music that must be cleared for commercial use, or a song that switches genre partway through.

audio_editing_model.instructions: Which model should edit the audio in this request, if any?

criteria.none: The request does not ask to change an existing audio file.
criteria.elevenlabs-music-v2: Any edit to an existing song or track, such as changing or replacing a section.
